title: Support UC Care
subtitle: Voluntary tip jar to keep the project free, private, and evolving
cardDesc: UC Care is 100% free, open source, and ad-free for all IBD patients.
philosophyDesc: We believe health tracking should never have paywalls. No clinical feature in this app is or will ever be restricted. Your donation is a voluntary contribution to help cover developer fees, security updates, and continuous clinical tools.
pixSectionDesc: Donate any amount directly from your Brazilian bank account without fees:
pasteInBankTip: 💡 Open your banking app and paste under PIX > E-mail Key.
internationalDesc: Prefer donating with a credit card or supporting open source?
thankYouDesc: Thank you to everyone who supports and helps build a safer, more welcoming tool for people living with IBD.
